audienceActivation.mappingGuidance:
Map every clean identifier you have. TikTok matches on any provided identifier — each is standalone-sufficient. Use field names below verbatim as `to`; they are exactly what get_audience_destination_schema returns in fields[].name.

All 6 fields are identifier slots whose suffix names the hash algorithm the integration applies — not a cue to hash the values yourself:
- EMAIL_SHA256, PHONE_SHA256 — for email and phone.
- IDFA_SHA256 (iOS), AAID_SHA256 (Android) — mobile advertising IDs.
- IDFA_MD5, AAID_MD5 — same mobile IDs in MD5, legacy only. Prefer the SHA256 variants.

Send RAW warehouse values. The integration hashes (using the algorithm named in the field) and normalizes (email→lowercase, phone→E.164 digits-only) on send. Do NOT pre-hash.
